baseline_models.mechanism: A social-cultic separation is paired with joining a refuge, and the spatial contraction becomes the site of an unfolding rather than an empty retreat.

activation_trace.role: Removal to a side supplies the deliberate break from the prior social field.
Submissive worship identifies the relation from which the separation is made.
Joining a gathering direction makes the break a positive relocation.
The refuge gives the relocation a protective destination.
Opening and spreading reverse the apparent constriction of entering the cave.

changed_reading.before: Withdraw and hide in a cave.
changed_reading.after: Transfer out of one field of attachment into gathered refuge, where enclosure becomes the means of expansion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ينشر لكم ربكم من رحمته ويهيئ لكم من أمركم مرفقا
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordly nurture spreads care and actively reconfigures the group's own affair into usable benefit, ease, and support.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord the ongoing arranger of the process.
Tender care supplies the quality that is spread into their situation.
Preparation and repair make the promised benefit an arranged condition.
Their affair or condition is the material being reconfigured.
Usable benefit and ease name the practical output of the preparation.

changed_reading.before: A general promise of comfort after flight.
changed_reading.after: A promise that their difficult affair will be worked into concrete affordances for living through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer for given mercy and prepared right handling is recast as a promise of spread mercy and prepared practical benefit; mirfaq becomes an enacted form of the requested rushd.

activation_trace.role: Tender mercy is first requested, supplying the prospective content of the later spreading.
Preparation frames the prayer as a request for an arranged course.
Their affair is already the object within which preparation is requested.
Sound handling of an affair supplies the requested directional outcome.
Practical benefit renders the earlier request for sound handling as a livable provision.

structural_cues: 18:10 is a first-person prayer; 18:16 repeats its cave-mercy-prepare-affair frame as a second-person promise and replaces final rushd with mirfaq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and rushd/mirfaq substitution; I infer promise-as-answer and a practicalization of guidance, while a live alternative is simple narrative restatement with a different benefit.

changed_reading.before: Mirfaq is an independent comfort promised in the cave.
changed_reading.after: Mirfaq is the concrete, inhabitable answer to their earlier request for rightly handled circumstances.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withdrawal comes after fortified public witness and before a stated danger of forced religious return, so it functions as a timed anti-coercion boundary rather than pre-emptive silence.

activation_trace.role: Binding and steadying the heart supplies inner stabilization before overt action.
Resolute rising into an affair supplies the youths' public phase before withdrawal.
Removal to a side marks the strategic boundary after that public stand.
Return after departure supplies the threatened reversal of the boundary.
An adhered-to religion identifies the social order into which recapture would absorb them.

structural_cues: The sequence is heart-fortification and standing speech in 18:14, diagnosis of the people's worship in 18:15, withdrawal in 18:16, and warning of forced return in 18:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered witness-withdrawal-return sequence; I infer a phased boundary strategy, while the alternative is that the sequence reports this case without making timing part of the focus command.

changed_reading.before: Separation is avoidance of religious disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Separation is a boundary enacted after witness to prevent coercive reversal into the former cultic order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared mirfaq appears as a managed habitat: solar exposure is diverted, the occupants lie in an expanded interior interval, and their bodies are repeatedly turned.

activation_trace.role: Active preparation licenses reading the following conditions as an arrangement.
Inclining aside supplies controlled deviation of the sun from the cave.
Cutting across and passing to one side reinforces the skirting solar path.
A widened interval supplies inhabitable space inside the enclosure.
Turning a thing from one face to another supplies bodily maintenance within the habitat.
Benefit and ease name the function jointly served by those environmental conditions.

structural_cues: 18:17 pairs sunrise and sunset deviations around a central cave gap; 18:18 repeats right and left in the turning of the sleepers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solar deviation, interior spacing, and bodily turning; I infer that these concretize preparation and mirfaq, while they could instead be read only as separate signs of protection.

changed_reading.before: The cave is a static hiding place in which mercy occurs.
changed_reading.after: The cave becomes a dynamically maintained microhabitat whose spatial and bodily conditions are the prepared ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prepared ease extends through the group's own coordinated means: money, acquired sustenance, and precise concealment connect cave refuge to the city without dissolving the boundary.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and branching allow mercy to be realized through a chain of means.
Money supplies the portable resource by which refuge reconnects selectively with the city.
Nourishing provision supplies the practical aim of the mission.
Fineness and hidden precision make discretion part of the provision mechanism.
Usable benefit gathers the money, food, and discretion into one promised affordance.

structural_cues: 18:19 forms an imperative chain: dispatch one member, use the silver, obtain food, bring provision, act subtly, and alert no one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the operational chain; I infer that human deliberation and ordinary resources mediate the promised mercy, while the alternative is that 18:19 is merely later survival action rather than fulfillment of mirfaq.

changed_reading.before: Divine ease means passive protection inside an isolated cave.
changed_reading.after: Divine ease is distributed through disciplined group agency that secures provision while preserving the protective boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the anatomical womb branch of رحم and the revival branch of نشر; the cave-mercy-spreading sequence keeps it anchored, but downstream prose should call it womb-like or gestational rather than claim those senses as the verse's lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الكهف ... ينشر لكم ربكم من رحمته

activation_trace.role: A cavity in the mountain supplies the enclosing chamber.
The womb as a vessel of growth supplies the exploratory gestational analogy.
Revival after death supplies re-emergence from protected suspension.
Nurture through successive states supplies the developmental process.

changed_reading.before: The cave is only a defensive enclosure.
changed_reading.after: The cave can be carried as a womb-like interval in which mercy preserves and develops life for renewed emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the repeated أمر across a temporal ownership reversal; the exact recurrence and dispute/dominance sequence keep it anchored, but downstream prose should present an agency contrast and not infer that the later building or prayer place is itself condemned.

activation_trace.role: Preparation makes their own affair beneficially arranged for them.
Their affair or condition is initially held in a second-person frame of benefit.
Competing pulls between parties turn the sleepers' affair into public contention.
The repeated affair language shifts from what is disputed about them to what dominant people control.
Overpowering dominance supplies the later transfer of decision-making agency.
A place of prostration supplies the public construction chosen over them.

changed_reading.before: Their affair is simply a difficult circumstance made easy.
changed_reading.after: The promised mirfaq also preserves a temporary sphere of agency over their affair before outsiders later contest and appropriate its public meaning.

strongest_changes: The requested rushd of 18:10 becomes the practical mirfaq promised in 18:16.
Withdrawal follows public witness and protects against the forced religious return named in 18:20.
Prepared ease unfolds as both a maintained cave habitat and the discreet provisioning operation of 18:19.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses prayer, boundary, habitat, and agency into one movement: separation enters refuge, mercy expands there, and the group's affair is converted into usable means.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact force of min amrikum may be source, partitive relation, or circumstance.
The environmental and provisioning details may instantiate mirfaq or may only follow it as separate narrative signs.
The gestational and affair-ownership readings remain analogical and exploratory.
